name: AAON Inc.
summary:
AAON (AAON) reported earnings of $0.69 per share on revenue of $626.98 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.52 per share on revenue of $514.70 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.55 per share. The company beat expectations by 25.45% while revenue grew 101.23% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 revenue of $2.24 billion to $2.31 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $2.02 billion to $2.09 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $2.07 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

AAON Inc is engaged in manufactures and sales of air conditioning and heating equipment consisting of rooftop units, chillers, air-handling units, make-up air units, heat recovery units, condensing units and coils.
subject: AAON Beat Expectations
